summary.rationale: Per Layer 3 Rule 7 (advanced nuclear / SMR enabler calibration) and cohort metadata (LEU is real-revenue control), divergence engine confirms: (i) DOE HALEU contract record on USAspending matches and slightly exceeds disclosed magnitude under correct subsidiary recipient (American Centrifuge Operating LLC); (ii) Piketon OH and Oak Ridge TN facilities both registered in EPA FRS at exact stated addresses; (iii) $0.5M LEU-Production task order found dollar-for-dollar in USAspending; (iv) absence of utility-customer-CIK Centrus mentions explained by heuristic #7 (sub-materiality threshold for buyer disclosure) and 10-K's own customer-anonymization. The two UNVERIFIABLE claims reflect (a) post-cutoff timing for a Jan 5 2026 task-order announcement awaiting definitive agreement, and (b) USPTO ODP namespace collision with Centrus Diagnostics + single-token assignee-match limitation — neither is a divergence signal.
